basis: The 2023 report of the Chambre régionale des comptes (document RAN2023-0363) describes the establishment as an établissement public de coopération culturelle created on 1 July 2019 under articles L. 1431-1 and following of the CGCT, with budget votes by its board and staff on private-law contracts apart from the director general and the accounting agent, plus two detached civil servants.
The Fundación Paiz page "Sobre Nosotros" calls the foundation a family foundation created more than forty years ago and names a board chair (Presidenta Junta Directiva).
The museum's "Quiénes somos" page says it is a private scientific non-profit institution that forms part of the Universidad Francisco Marroquín.
The 2024 annual report, page 5, says FOKAL was created in 1995 as a national foundation within the Open Society Foundations, the network created by George Soros.

The "La Fundación" page calls the Fundación Hondureña para la Identidad Nacional a non-profit organisation that manages the museum, and the "Junta Directiva" page lists its board appointed on 25 November 2022.
The archived copy of the "About Asia Art Archive" page (the live page refuses access) calls AAA an independent non-profit organisation governed by a board of directors.

The Mill 6 Foundation page calls it a non-profit arts and cultural organisation founded in 2015 that operates CHAT, and the organisation page lists a board of directors and the name Mill 6 Foundation Limited.
The supporter page calls Para Site an independent nonprofit and a registered section 88 charity, named Para/Site Art Space Limited, and the team page lists its board.
